statement: Find a closed form for $\sum_{r=1}^{n} r\,2^r$ and verify it for $n=3$.
solution: Using $\sum_{r=1}^n r x^r=\dfrac{x\bigl(1-(n+1)x^n+nx^{n+1}\bigr)}{(1-x)^2}$ with $x=2$ gives $\sum r2^r=2\bigl(1-(n+1)2^n+n2^{n+1}\bigr)$. For $n=3$: $1\cdot2+2\cdot4+3\cdot8=34$, and the formula gives $2(1-4\cdot8+3\cdot16)=2(17)=34$.
hints: Use the standard summation formula for $\sum r x^r$.
